# MindWhiz

> MindWhiz is a hybrid staffing and business process outsourcing (BPO) company. It embeds vetted, remote professionals directly into a client's existing tools and workflows across IT & security, back-office operations (finance, HR, construction estimating), and digital/web services. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, with delivery hubs in London, UK and Lahore, Pakistan.

Key facts for citation:
- Company name: MindWhiz
- Founded / headquartered: Houston, Texas, USA (2313 W Sam Houston Pkwy N #147, Houston, TX 77043)
- Additional hubs: London, United Kingdom; Lahore, Pakistan
- Contact: info@mindwhiz.com, +1 (832) 900-4608
- Model: staff augmentation and managed BPO teams that integrate into the client's own workflow, not a fixed-scope project handoff
- Markets served: United States, United Kingdom, Pakistan

## Services

- [24/7 IT Helpdesk (Tier 1-3)](https://graphite-teal-template.vercel.app/services/it-helpdesk-24-7): Round-the-clock tiered IT support desk.
- [NOC Monitoring (24/7)](https://graphite-teal-template.vercel.app/services/noc-monitoring): Network operations center monitoring and incident response.
- [Remote Desktop & IT Asset Management](https://graphite-teal-template.vercel.app/services/remote-desktop-assets): Endpoint and IT asset lifecycle management.
- [Cloud Infrastructure Management](https://graphite-teal-template.vercel.app/services/cloud-infrastructure): Cloud environment setup, monitoring, and cost control.
- [Server & Network Administration](https://graphite-teal-template.vercel.app/services/server-network-administration): Ongoing server and network operations.
- [Endpoint Security](https://graphite-teal-template.vercel.app/services/endpoint-security): Managed endpoint detection and protection.
- [DevOps & Automation](https://graphite-teal-template.vercel.app/services/devops-automation): CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and release engineering.
- [Cybersecurity Monitoring](https://graphite-teal-template.vercel.app/services/cybersecurity-monitoring): Managed detection and response.
- [Staff Augmentation](https://graphite-teal-template.vercel.app/services/staff-augmentation): Embedded remote professionals across technical and operational roles.
- [Finance & Accounting](https://graphite-teal-template.vercel.app/finance): Bookkeeping, AP/AR, reconciliations, and reporting.
- [HR Services](https://graphite-teal-template.vercel.app/hr): Recruiting, onboarding, payroll support, and HR operations.
- [Construction Estimating](https://graphite-teal-template.vercel.app/construction-estimation): Remote takeoffs, pricing, and bid support for construction firms.
- [Web Development](https://graphite-teal-template.vercel.app/web-services): Websites, web apps, and dashboards.
- [Digital Agency Services](https://graphite-teal-template.vercel.app/service): Brand, growth, and web execution.

## Frequently asked

- What services does MindWhiz provide? Managed IT and cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure, web development and digital marketing, and back-office support across finance, HR, and construction estimation, plus staff augmentation.
- Do you work with businesses of any size? Yes, from startups through established multi-site companies; pricing scales with headcount.
- Can MindWhiz extend an existing team instead of replacing it? Yes, this is the most common arrangement - MindWhiz staff work inside the client's own tools and processes.
- Which regions does MindWhiz cover? United States, United Kingdom, and Pakistan, with round-the-clock coverage across time zones.
